name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for APIWatch
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement, needs-review
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to APIWatch.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What pain point does it address?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like in detail. Include:

- How the user would interact with this feature
- Any UI/UX considerations
- Technical implementation notes (if known)

## Alternatives
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Priority
How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - blocking my use case
- [ ] High - very important for my workflow
- [ ] Medium - nice to have
- [ ] Low - would be convenient

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
